{{short description|2023 hurling tournament in Ireland and England}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 2023 National Hurling League |image = |dates = 4 February – 9 April 2023 |teams = 35 |team1 = Limerick |captain1 = [[Cian Lynch]] |manager1 = [[John Kiely (Limerick hurler)|John Kiely]] |titles = 14th |team2 = Kilkenny |captain2 = [[Eoin Cody]] |manager2 = [[Derek Lyng]] |twoa = Offaly |twob=Meath |threea = Roscommon |threeb = Cavan |previous = [[2022 National Hurling League|2022]] |next = [[2024 National Hurling League|2024]] }} The '''2023 National Hurling League''', known for sponsorship reasons as the '''Allianz Hurling League''', was the 92nd season of the [[National Hurling League]], an annual [[hurling]] competition held in [[Ireland]] for [[GAA County|county]] teams. Three [[England|English]] county teams also feature. [[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] were the title holders.{{Cite web|url=https://punditarena.com/gaa/james-fenton/gaa-changes-calendar-2023/|title=GAA 2023: Proposed changes to inter-county calendar in full|first=James|last=Fenton|date=September 22, 2022}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.skysports.com/gaa/hurling/news/30554/12696250/hurlings-new-intercounty-managers-for-2023-the-big-appointments-after-a-hectic-off-season-of-changes|title=Hurling's new intercounty managers for 2023: The big appointments after a hectic off-season of changes|website=Sky Sports}} It took place between 4 February and 9 April.{{Cite web|url=https://www.irishexaminer.com/sport/gaa/arid-40928021.html|title=John Fogarty: How the 2023 GAA season will be different|first=John|last=Fogarty|date=July 28, 2022|website=Irish Examiner}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.gaa.ie/news/gaa-master-fixtures-for-2023-published/|title=GAA Master Fixtures for 2023 published|website=www.gaa.ie}} On 9 April, [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] won the National Hurling League for the fourteenth time after a 2–20 to 0–15 win against [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] in the final.{{cite web|url= https://www.rte.ie/sport/hurling/2023/0409/1376051-classy-limerick-claim-league-honours-with-ease/|title=Classy Limerick claim league honours with ease|date=9 April 2023|work=RTE Sport|accessdate=12 April 2023}} {{TOC Limit|3}} ==Format== '''League structure''' Thirty-five teams compete in the 2023 NHL – * twelve teams organised in two six-team groups of approximately equal strength in Division 1{{Cite web|url=https://www.skysports.com/gaa/hurling/news/30554/12332244/2022-national-hurling-and-football-leagues-groups-confirmed-for-all-divisions|title=2022 National Hurling and Football Leagues: Groups confirmed for all divisions|website=Sky Sports}} * six teams in Divisions 2A, 2B and 3A * five teams in Division 3B. All thirty-two county teams from Ireland take part. [[London GAA|London]], [[Lancashire GAA|Lancashire]] and Warwickshire complete the lineup.{{Cite web|url=https://www.sportsjoe.ie/gaa/congress-approves-new-championship-restructure-2023-250889|title=Congress approves new championship restructure for 2023 with 94.7% approval|website=SportsJOE.ie}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.colerainechronicle.co.uk/gaa/2023/02/10/news/fascinating-ties-in-allianz-hurling-league-round-two-39485/|title=Fascinating ties in Allianz Hurling League Round Two|first=Damian|last=Mullan|website=www.colerainechronicle.co.uk}} {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" |- ! colspan=7 | Teams by Province and Division |- ! Two points are awarded for a win, and one for a draw. '''Tie-breaker''' * If only two teams are level on league points, the team that won the head-to-head match is ranked ahead. If this game was a draw, score difference (total scored minus total conceded in all games) is used to rank the teams. * If three or more teams are level on league points, score difference is used to rank the teams. '''Finals, promotions and relegations''' '''Division 1''' *The top two teams in each group play in the NHL semi-finals and final. * The bottom team in each group meet in a relegation play-off, with the losers being relegated to Division 2A '''Division 2A''' *Second and third place meet in the Division 2A semi-final * The first-placed team plays the semi-final winner in the Division 2A final, with the winners being promoted to Division 1 * The bottom team is relegated to Division 2B '''Division 2B''' *Second and third place meet in the Division 2B semi-final * The first-placed team plays the semi-final winner in the Division 2B final, with the winners being promoted to Division 2A * The bottom two teams meet in a relegation play-off, with the losers being relegated to Division 3A '''Division 3A''' *Second and third place meet in the Division 3A semi-final * The first-placed team plays the semi-final winner in the Division 3A final, with the winners being promoted to Division 2B * The bottom team is relegated to Division 3B '''Division 3B''' *Second and third place meet in the Division 3B semi-final * The first-placed team plays the semi-final winner in the Division 3B final, with the winners being promoted to Division 3A{{cite news|url=https://www.rte.ie/sport/gaa/2017/0328/863125-hurling-league-structure/|title=Hurling League structure to remain in place for 2018|date=28 March 2017|via=www.rte.ie}} ==Division 1== {{Location map+ | Ireland | AlternativeMap = Island of Ireland location map.svg | width = 350 | caption = Locations of the 2023 NHL Division 1 teams.
